common_contract.currentness: every record generation equals independently pinned anchor generation; no wall clock or TTL
common_contract.identity: full kind/namespace/sha256 equality; sha256 of canonical body is a separate CONTENT_IDENTITY
common_contract.lineage: source and target same adopted selected lineage under explicit rule
common_contract.scope: all records envelope equals expected envelope in full
common_contract.trust: independently supplied exact record grants, never submission-supplied grants
common_contract.unknown: FALSE, no implicit conversion or missing-value defaults

obligations.evidence_requirement: Catalog membership/resolution or publication record with governing publication rule.
obligations.proposition: Authority is available from competent owning domain and published as required; explicit exemption is the only alternative.

obligations.evidence_requirement: Scope binding plus independently adopted rule and exact application.
obligations.proposition: Recorded source scope applies to this target operation under an adopted rule.
obligations.rejection: wrong scope or representation decision substituted for applicability

obligations.evidence_requirement: Current lineage/selection binding; supported profile uses direct authenticated selection rather than chain traversal.
obligations.proposition: Source and target have current applicable lineage without disqualifying supersession.
obligations.rejection: different lineage, missing selection, or supersession

obligations.evidence_requirement: Owning content-verification attestation and current selection under governing rule; not copied runtime references.
obligations.proposition: Exact runtime content and selection linkage is independently verified and applicable.
obligations.rejection: wrong runtime or unverified content linkage

obligations.evidence_requirement: Authenticated generation selection and membership proof.
obligations.proposition: Owning authority belongs to exact currently applicable G4 generation.

obligations.evidence_requirement: Owning identity proof plus target-profile binding, or authenticated explicit exemption.
obligations.proposition: Pinned profile governs target where required, or explicit rule establishes non-applicability.
obligations.rejection: wrong identity domain or missing applicability binding

obligations.evidence_requirement: Current validity/usage record plus trusted anchor and applicable rule; no inferred TTL.
obligations.proposition: Authority remains valid for exact evaluation target under governing validity/usage rules.
obligations.rejection: revoked, consumed, stale, or unknown validity

obligations.evidence_requirement: Adopted phase rule and exact application with exclusions.
obligations.proposition: Existing phase rule permits reference in preconstruction without execution or consumption.
obligations.rejection: absent rule, denied phase, or runtime effect expansion

retry.meaning: budget positive/negative oracle prerequisite ready; not a C06A PASS or waiver of decision-route/full-import requirements
